metadata.case_name: SEN HEM PRATAP v. HANG YUE ENGINEERING LTD

injuries.description: a small metallic foreign body over his right cornea with removal
source: a florescent staining revealed a foreign body over his right cornea.
a small metallic foreign body was found over his right cornea with removal done.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of eye or orbit

injuries.description: permanent scar(s) at the cornea / right eye pupil (3 non-axial corneal scars)
source: a permanent scar was left at his right eye pupil.
there were 3 non-axial corneal scars at the cornea of the right eye and thus Pratap must have suffered from more than one episodes of foreign body lodging onto the cornea in the past.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic injury to eyeball

source: he received treatment for left eye anterior uveitis [an inflammatory condition affecting the unveal tissues of any eye] which is unrelated to the Accident.

manifestations.description: pain and burning sensation at his right eye
could not sleep well at night because of the pain and burning sensation
his visual power is very poor; his visual power is deteriorating and he has to wear spectacles

treatments_received.treatment: removal of small metallic foreign body from right cornea
source: a small metallic foreign body was found over his right cornea with removal done.

treatments_received.treatment: treated with some oral analgesics and referral to Tuen Mun Eye Centre
source: treated with some oral analgesics and was referred to Tuen Mun Eye Centre.
He attended altogether 15 medical and follow-up sessions between 13 November 2008 and 7 September 2009.
